title: Prologue to Abyss (2/3)
body:
Every Monday we only have one subject, Sir Maxwell's Introduction to Psychology. It's always a problem of mine how will I spend the rest of the day. Me and Ian had an early lunch so now I'm alone since Ian still has lessons to attend to, plus he also has this puzzles club while I, on the other hand, decided not to submerge myself into any co-curricular activities.

I've found myself outside the university's premise in this staggering heat. I'm just a wandering girl nothing better to do. I'm not really fond of studying in the first place. I will not waste my whole time studying. Well, alone time with myself is a nice change of pace once in a while, except that this scene is always what happens every Monday.

I don't want to bother my classmates, they must be busy studying right now. I'm not as hard working as they are. So at the least, I don't want them to consider me as a bad influence to their studies. I'll just kill time at the town's park, look at people and maybe indulge myself with ice cream. Ice cream's perfect in this kind of heat. Now my mouth's craving for one.

This place's quite good. I'm seating on a bench under the shade of an Acacia Tree, observing how slowly the world goes here compared to urban cities. The wind blows gently just enough to fight the heat that will last for seconds. Yet, people are still busy doing their own trade. I'm really having an easy life. Now, if only I would have a boyfriend sitting beside me, everything would be perfect.

"Hey, I want an ice cream, could you get me one, please?" said the person sitting next to me.

While I was lost in thoughts, I didn't notice that there's already a person beside me. Looking at him, I'm inclined to think that he's around the same age as me. He looked like a homeless person though.

"Uhhh?!" I arbitrarily said.

The man looked at me with confusion and said "Ahhh, I forgot to tell you the flavor - I want chocolate ice cream."

Since there's a man selling dirty ice cream not too far away from us I decided to buy. Is this the latest modus of hypnotism? Because I went on and buy 2 chocolate flavored ice cream. Well, I don't think so, I'm a psychology student, petty tricks won't work on me. I'm just a kind girl, that's all. Giving him an ice cream instead of money will be better after all.

While enjoying our ice cream, I'm eagerly waiting for him to say "thank you" but silence is his way of thanking me, I guess. Do homeless people don't know how to appreciate things nowadays?

Now, I'm sitting with a guy, not my boyfriend though. Good thing he's not bothering me.

Then, I suddenly remembered the odd, creepy writing on the board at our classroom. I don't care if Ian and Sir Maxwell can't make sense out of it. At least, I believe that I'm smarter than Ian. So maybe if I would focus real hard, I can find answers. Good thing I haven't deleted the picture yet. Since I have nothing better to do anyway.

As I'm looking intensely at my phone, I can sense that the guy near me is getting close to me. It is somewhat annoying, but I don't want to look like some nagging, discriminating girl so I decided to bare with him and stayed quiet.

But he suddenly snatched my phone out my hand!

And just when I thought that he will start to run, he himself stared at the photo.

I snapped "Hey you! Give me my phone! Is this how you'll repay me after I've treated you ice cream? You're still young, why not try to look for a job? And stop stealing someone's phone---"

"She needs help, I hope it's not serious but can I look at your gallery, B.S?" he calmly said.

"What the hell? B.S? How dare you call me B.S?!! Give me my phone!" i shouted.

"B.S. --- Brianna Sheiyreen" he said without looking at me.

What a scandalous way to call me. I can't even respond. He must have known my name because of my wall paper. This guy is really getting in my nerves.

"Aha! I found her" he said.

"Ha? Who did you find? A girl? What are you talking about" i said out of confusion.

"Her." he said as he shows to me a photo of me with Michelle.

Michelle is fairly beautiful, I guess I can't blame him for falling suddenly in love with her, but of course I won't sell out my friend. Not to someone like him.

"Loko. Michelle's too good for you." I said pridefully. "Can you just give me my phone and think that this never happened. Just give me my phone, promise, I won't sue you"

He's not listening to me. He's busy with my phone. As if if he's texting someone.

"Hey! what are you doing with my phone?! Are you texting someone?! Give my phone or else!"

He gave me my phone then stood up. I quickly scanned my phone and found out that he texted Michelle.

"Why you?! Why did you text her?" I shouted.

"Stand up already, we're going to meet your classmate Michelle." he said.

I hate this feeling. He's not listening to me, not one bit. He's way too self-centered for a homeless person.

I read what his message to Michelle was. Then I was shocked.

XV.XI..XIII.V.V.XX..XIII.V..I.XX..XX.VIII.V..XVI.I.XVIII.XI.

"You?! Wait? Was it really a code then?" I confusedly asked.

"Get up, it's hot in here. Let's go inside that convenience store" he said while pointing the store perpendicular to us.

I want to ask too many questions but decided to comply with what he said first.

"Now that we're here in the convenience store, please answer my question - was Michelle the one who wrote that one on the blackboard?" I impatiently asked.

"I don't know. Let's wait for her - if she didn't come then maybe I'm wrong." he said while looking outside.

Now I'm more confused. It's like I was left behind in a foreign country and can't understand a damn thing he's saying.

But after a few minutes, I was stunned when I saw someone running as if she's hurriedly looking for someone.

It was Michelle!
